events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents the Wynton Marsalis Quintet in Rose Theater on January 7, 8 and 9, 2027, at 7:30 PM each night. JALC calls this a special lineup with Wynton Marsalis, pianist Marcus Roberts, bassist Reginald Veal, drummer Jason Marsalis and a guest tenor saxophonist still to be announced. JALC's official 2026-27 season announcement states that the group will make contemporary interpretations of selected repertoire from the early albums Black Codes (From the Underground), Hot House Flowers and Think of One, as well as music from Integrity Suite and compositions by New Orleans modernists James Black and Ellis Marsalis that the Marsalis brothers learned during their formative years. The January 9 authorized ticket page currently exposes selectable seats with $30-$165 face values plus a $12 fee; prices for the other performances are not generalized from that page.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to hear this is not Marsalis's stature by itself; it is the way JALC has built the quintet around a specific historical conversation. Marcus Roberts, Reginald Veal and Jason Marsalis form a rhythm section with deep roots in the Marsalis musical world, while the program reaches from the early-1980s language of Think of One, Hot House Flowers and Black Codes into Integrity Suite and the New Orleans writing of James Black and Ellis Marsalis. That gives the night a real live question: what does this repertoire become when a present-day quintet reopens it instead of simply commemorating it?
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play January 7-9, actively make room for one of the Rose Theater nights and let it anchor that evening. From farther down the corridor, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than turn a three-performance engagement into a single-show up-and-back mission.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para escucharlo no es la estatura de Marsalis por sí sola, sino la conversación histórica concreta que JALC armó alrededor de este quinteto. Marcus Roberts, Reginald Veal y Jason Marsalis forman una sección rítmica con raíces profundas en el mundo musical de Marsalis, mientras el programa va del lenguaje de los primeros años ochenta de Think of One, Hot House Flowers y Black Codes hasta Integrity Suite y la escritura de los modernistas de Nueva Orleans James Black y Ellis Marsalis. Eso le da a la noche una pregunta real en vivo: ¿en qué se convierte este repertorio cuando un quinteto actual lo vuelve a abrir en lugar de limitarse a conmemorarlo?
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego del 7 al 9 de enero, le haría espacio activamente a una de las noches en Rose Theater y dejaría que ordene esa velada. Desde más abajo en el corredor, la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en Nueva York en vez de convertir una residencia de tres funciones en un viaje de ida y vuelta por un solo show.
